plan.notes: Source: official NOVA Academic Catalog program page https://catalog.nvcc.edu/programs/computer-science-as/ and its linked official program PDF https://catalog.nvcc.edu/programs/computer-science-as/computer-science-as.pdf (NOVA Code 2460, CIP 11.0701, titled 'Computer Science, A.S.' — verified as an A.S., not A.A.S.). Catalog year 2025-2026: the catalog homepage (checked 2026-09-30) identifies the official catalog as the '2025-2026 NOVA Catalog'; no 2026-2027 catalog was published on catalog.nvcc.edu as of that date. Transcribed 2026-09-30 from the PDF's semester-by-semester tables (codes, titles, credits copied verbatim); semester subtotals and course order cross-checked against the official NOVA/GMU ADVANCE 2025-2026 A.S. Computer Science pathway, which lists the same NOVA degree requirements in the same sequence. Credit verification: catalog semester subtotals are 15-16 + 14 + 15 + 16-18 = 60-63 total, matching the catalog's stated 'Total Credits 60-63'; the standard path transcribed here (minimum option credits: MTH 167, CSC 208, CSC 205, 3-cr approved elective) sums to exactly 60. Caveats: (1) Semester 1 math is an either/or block (5-6 cr). Option 1 (PreCalculus needed): MTH 167 (5 cr), or MTH 161 (3 cr) + MTH 162 (3 cr) — transcribed. Option 2 (placed out of PreCalculus): catalog footnote 1 directs these students to follow the alternate option-2 course sequence and consult an advisor; the option-2 courses did not extract legibly from the official catalog PDF, so they are NOT transcribed here (nothing invented). (2) The two Humanities/Fine Arts electives must be chosen from two of the three areas (Fine Arts, Humanities, Literature); no credit if both come from the same area. (3) The Social/Behavioral Sciences elective must not be a History course (catalog footnote; semester 1 already requires a HIS elective). (4) MTH 245 Statistics I may satisfy a math area if the transfer institution requires it. (5) CSC courses used for this program may not be more than 10 years old as of the first day of the fall semester of the graduation academic year, unless approved by the pathway dean. (6) Per-course prerequisites are not stated in the program sequence and are left empty (not inferred). (7) 'Approved Elective (p. 2)' = 3-4 credits from the catalog's 21-course Approved Electives list (transcribed as options; CSC 195/295 are 1-5 variable-credit topics courses).

courses.title: Introduction to Problem Solving and Programming
HIS Elective — History (choose one)
courses.choice_note: Select any HIS course from the social/behavioral science General Education Electives; choose with an advisor to meet the transfer institution's requirements.

courses.title: PreCalculus with Trigonometry
courses.choice_note: Catalog Option 1 (PreCalculus needed): MTH 167 (5 cr), or MTH 161 (3 cr) + MTH 162 (3 cr). Catalog Option 2 (placed out of PreCalculus): per catalog footnote 1, follow the alternate option-2 course sequence — consult an academic advisor. The option-2 courses did not extract legibly from the official catalog PDF and are not transcribed here.
